name: Libposie
author: admin@libposie.local
description: Libposie — a self-hosted, multi-user personal book library PWA. Scan ISBNs, catalogue your shelves, share books publicly and manage lending with due-date reminders. Node.js + SQLite, no database server required.
startup: APP_DIR=.; if [[ ! -f ./package.json ]] && [[ -f /mnt/server/package.json ]]; then APP_DIR=/mnt/server; elif [[ ! -f ./package.json ]] && [[ -f /home/container/package.json ]]; then APP_DIR=/home/container; fi; if [[ -d "${APP_DIR}" ]]; then cd "${APP_DIR}"; fi; if [[ "${AUTO_UPDATE}" == "1" ]] && [[ -d .git ]]; then git config --global --add safe.directory "${APP_DIR}"; git fetch --depth 1 origin "${GIT_BRANCH}" && git reset --hard "origin/${GIT_BRANCH}" && npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund; fi; node server/index.js

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Libposie installation script
# Runs in a temporary container; the server files live in /mnt/server

set -e

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: No repository address was provided."
    exit 1
fi

BRANCH="${GIT_BRANCH:-main}"
REPO="${GIT_ADDRESS}"
case "${REPO}" in
    *.git) ;;
    *) REPO="${REPO}.git" ;;
esac

AUTH_REPO="${REPO}"
if [ -n "${GIT_USERNAME}" ] && [ -n "${GIT_TOKEN}" ]; then
    AUTH_REPO="https://${GIT_USERNAME}:${GIT_TOKEN}@${REPO#https://}"
fi

if command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    git config --global --add safe.directory /mnt/server

    if [ -d /mnt/server/.git ]; then
        echo "Existing checkout found — updating to ${BRANCH}"
        git remote set-url origin "${AUTH_REPO}"
        git fetch --depth 1 origin "${BRANCH}"
        git reset --hard "origin/${BRANCH}"
        git clean -fd -e data -e .env -e node_modules
    else
        echo "Cloning ${REPO} (${BRANCH})"
        rm -rf /tmp/libposie
        git clone --depth 1 --branch "${BRANCH}" "${AUTH_REPO}" /tmp/libposie
        cp -a /tmp/libposie/. /mnt/server/
        rm -rf /tmp/libposie
    fi
else
    echo "git is unavailable — downloading a source tarball instead"
    curl -sSL "${REPO%.git}/archive/refs/heads/${BRANCH}.tar.gz" | tar -xz --strip-components=1 -C /mnt/server
fi

if [ ! -f /mnt/server/package.json ]; then
    echo "ERROR: package.json was not found — check the repository address and branch."
    exit 1
fi

echo "Installing production dependencies"
cd /mnt/server
npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund

# SQLite database, WAL files and the auto-generated session secret live here.
mkdir -p /mnt/server/data

echo "----------------------------------------"
echo "Libposie installation complete."
echo "Start the server, then open it in a browser."
echo "The FIRST account you register becomes the administrator."
echo "----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Repository address
variables.description: The Git repository Libposie is installed from. Change this if you run your own fork.

variables.name: Git username
variables.description: Only needed for a private repository. Leave blank otherwise.

variables.name: Git access token
variables.description: Personal access token for a private repository. Leave blank otherwise.

variables.name: Auto update on boot
variables.description: Set to 1 to pull the latest code and reinstall dependencies every time the server starts.

variables.name: Session secret
variables.description: Signs login cookies. Leave blank and one is generated automatically and stored in data/.jwt-secret. Changing it signs everybody out.

variables.name: Secure cookies (HTTPS)
variables.description: Set to 1 when Libposie is served over HTTPS through a reverse proxy. Required for camera scanning and push notifications on remote devices.

variables.name: Allow registration
variables.description: Set to 0 to close sign-ups once your members have accounts. The very first account is always allowed and becomes the administrator.

variables.name: VAPID public key
variables.description: Web push public key. Leave blank to generate a pair automatically on first boot. Set both keys explicitly to keep push subscriptions working across reinstalls.

variables.name: VAPID private key
variables.description: Web push private key that pairs with the public key above.

variables.name: VAPID contact address
variables.description: Contact address sent to push services, e.g. mailto:you@example.com

variables.name: Google Books API key
variables.description: Optional. The anonymous Google Books quota is shared and often exhausted; a free API key makes that metadata source reliable.

variables.name: ISBNdb API key
variables.description: Optional third metadata source from https://isbndb.com

variables.name: Data directory
variables.description: Where the SQLite database is written, relative to the server root. Back this folder up.
